# Grid header text grows in windows under 600 px wide, popups included

## Context

The operator's v13.2 hand check (#14800, step 2, 2026-10-10 17:2xZ): a Workstation grid torn out into its own window (458×471 outer, the size PR #19559 gives it) shows its header text visibly larger than the same grid docked in the main window, while the body cells stay the same. His read: the docked size is the wanted one, at every window width.

## The Problem

`resources/scss/src/grid/header/Button.scss` lines 122–131: the header's `.neo-button-text` takes `var(--grid-header-button-font-size)` (13 px in neo-dark, 11 px in neo-light), but under `@media (max-width: 600px)` it switches to `var(--button-text-font-size)`, which is `--core-fontsize-label` = 1rem = 16 px. The query reads the window width: a 458 px popup counts as a phone, the same 458 px pane inside a 1254 px window does not, so the header grows from 13 to 16 px the moment a pane leaves the room.

The rule came from #6419 (d64f6fc67c, 2025-02-09), whose text says the opposite of what the rule does today: "The font-size does get increased a bit for default buttons, but this should not happen for the grid scope." `resources/scss/src/button/Base.scss` line 114 changes default button text to 13 px under the same query; the grid header's counter-rule was meant to keep the header out of that change, and it points at the larger size instead.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.grid.header.Button` extends `Neo.button.Base`, so Base's `.neo-button .neo-button-text` media rule reaches the header text. The header file needs its own rule under the same query to win regardless of stylesheet order (equal specificity).
- Window-width media queries in the engine SCSS: `button/Base.scss:114`, `toolbar/Base.scss:9`, `component/Markdown.scss:12`, `app/content/PageContainer.scss:16`, `grid/header/Button.scss:128`. A torn-out vessel is a narrow window by design (its outer size equals the pane's), so every one of these fires in a popup that a docked pane never triggers. This ticket fixes the one the operator saw; the rest is a product read, listed under Out of Scope.
- Design authority: #6419, "this should not happen for the grid scope", and the operator on 2026-10-10: the smaller, docked header size is the one he wants.

## The Fix

`resources/scss/src/grid/header/Button.scss`: inside the `@media (max-width: 600px)` block, `font-size: var(--grid-header-button-font-size)` instead of `var(--button-text-font-size)`, with the comment stating why the block exists (Base changes default button text on narrow windows; the header keeps its own size). No theme file changes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A component spec reads the header button text's computed `font-size` at a 1100 px and at a 500 px wide viewport: equal, and equal to the computed `--grid-header-button-font-size`.
- [ ] Post-merge, the operator's hand: a torn-out Workstation grid shows the docked header size.

## Out of Scope

- The other four window-width rules (toolbar, Markdown, PageContainer, default button text). Whether a narrow popup should ever count as a phone is a product decision for a separate ticket.
- Any token or rem change.
